description: This file provides type annotations and module declarations for Node.js's 'tty' module, defining classes ReadStream and WriteStream, and the function isatty, along with related types and constants.

classes.name: ReadStream
classes.description: Represents the readable side of a TTY, extending net.Socket, with properties and methods for raw mode configuration, TTY status, etc.

classes.name: WriteStream
classes.description: Represents the writable side of a TTY, extending net.Socket, with methods for cursor and screen control, color support, and window size information.

methods.name: function isatty(fd: number): boolean; isatty
methods.description: Checks if a file descriptor is associated with a TTY device.

methods.name: ReadStream.constructor
methods.description: Constructs a new ReadStream instance, optionally with raw mode configuration.

methods.name: ReadStream.setRawMode
methods.description: Sets the ReadStream to operate in raw mode or default mode.

methods.name: WriteStream.clearLine
methods.description: Clears the current line in the specified direction.

methods.name: WriteStream.clearScreenDown
methods.description: Clears the screen from the current cursor down.

methods.name: WriteStream.cursorTo
methods.description: Moves the cursor to specified coordinates.

methods.name: WriteStream.moveCursor
methods.description: Moves the cursor relative to its current position.

methods.name: WriteStream.getColorDepth
methods.description: Returns the color depth supported by the terminal.

methods.name: WriteStream.hasColors
methods.description: Checks if the terminal supports at least the specified number of colors.

methods.name: WriteStream.getWindowSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the terminal window as [columns, rows].
